title: "02 · Exploratory Factor Analysis"

## Fitting EFA in R

We fit a 3-factor oblimin-rotated EFA to 12 personality items using `psych::fa()`.

```{r}
#| eval: false
# fit oblimin-rotated 3-factor solution
library(psych)
fa_fit <- fa(items, nfactors = 3, rotate = "oblimin", fm = "ml")
print(fa_fit$loadings, cutoff = 0.3)
```

```
          ML1    ML2    ML3
item_01  0.71
item_02  0.68
item_05         0.74
item_06         0.61
item_09                0.79
item_10                0.66
SS loadings    2.31   1.98   1.74
```
